column1: # Case table for substrate/.github/workflows/npm-auto-release.yml
# TAB-separated: <name> <context k=v;k=v> <expect-run csv> <expect-skip csv>
# WHAT THIS PINS. npm-auto-release has exactly two jobs, bump -> ship, and only
# two context paths appear in any `if:` — github.actor (the bot re-trigger loop
# guard on bump) and needs.bump.outputs.bumped (the publish gate on ship). The
# table fixes the selected set for every combination that can actually occur.
# ROW 2 IS THE POINT OF THIS FILE, AND IT SAYS THE OPPOSITE OF ITS CARGO SIBLING.
# The sweep exists because cargo-auto-release publishes only when
#   needs.bump.outputs.bumped == 'true' && !github.event.repository.private
# so a private repo bumps, tags, pushes and publishes NOTHING, on purpose and
# silently. npm-auto-release DOES NOT CARRY THAT GUARD. Its ship condition is
# bumped == 'true' alone; github.event.repository.private appears in this file
# ONLY inside the two runs-on runner-routing expressions (lines 64 and 96),
# which select a runner and never gate a job. So a private repo running this
# workflow DOES publish to npmjs.org. Row 2 asserts that, deliberately, so the
# divergence is written down instead of being assumed either way. If the guard
# is ever added to ship (matching the cargo posture), row 2 goes RED and names
# the change — which is the whole point of asserting the current behaviour
# rather than the behaviour someone expects.
# github.event.repository.private is declared in every case even though no
# `if:` reads it: it is the key the sweep is about, and a row that models "the
# private repo case" while never mentioning private would be unreadable.
# always() and github.event_name are declared for the same reason — a later
# always() on a retry/cleanup job must not silently re-read as undeclared.
# needs-propagation is asserted by row 4: bump is skipped by the bot guard, so
# ship is skipped too even though nothing about ship's own condition changed.
# Its bumped value is EMPTY, not 'false', because that is what a skipped
# upstream job yields — a distinct state the table is able to say.
public-bump
# THE DIVERGENCE ROW. Unlike cargo-auto-release, a PRIVATE repo publishes here.
private-bump-publishes-anyway
# No version change: bump runs and reports bumped=false; ship is correctly gated off.
public-no-bump
# Loop guard: the push that bump itself made must not re-enter. bump skips, and
# ship skips by needs-propagation (it declares no always()).
bot-push-loop-guard
